In a galaxy far, far away, the Lego Movie universe is in crisis. The evil Lord Business has taken over and is determined to enforce conformity and perfection with his Kragle weapon. Meanwhile, Emmet, an ordinary Lego minifigure, is mistakenly identified as the Special, a master builder who can save the world. With the help of a group of Master Builders and an instruction manual, Emmet embarks on a mission to stop Lord Business and save the galaxy.

The Millennium Falcon, piloted by Han Solo and Chewbacca, arrives to assist Emmet and the Master Builders. Han Solo, wielding a chicken leg, joins the Master Builders in their meetings in the "Dog" part of Cloud Cuckoo Land to discuss various issues.

In a related matter, a proposal has been put forth to establish a website and physical premises for the Master Builders. The terms of reference for this proposal include:

A. Understanding and acknowledging what went wrong and the key lessons that must be learned.

B. Obtaining all available relevant evidence from the Post Office, Fujitsu, BEIS and any other relevant sources.
